Since your order #W5061109 is still in pending status, I can help you. However, I need to explain a few important things:

1. Unfortunately, I cannot cancel just one item from an order. When modifying a pending order, we would need to cancel the entire order and place a new one, or modify all the items you want to keep.

2. Let me check what bluetooth speakers we have available in our catalog.

<antml:function_calls>
<antml:invoke name="list_all_product_types">
</antml:invoke>
</antml:function_calls>

I apologize, but I can see that all our bluetooth speakers are priced between $271.89 and $326.59. We don't currently have any bluetooth speakers available for under $100.

Would you like me to help you:
1. Cancel the entire pending order (#W5061109) which includes the bluetooth speaker, wireless earbuds, makeup kit, and office chair, or
2. Modify your order to switch to a less expensive bluetooth speaker model (the cheapest available is $271.89 with blue color, 20 hours battery life, but no water resistance)?

Please let me know which option you prefer, and I'll guide you through the process.

I'll help you modify your order to switch to the less expensive speaker model. Let me summarize the change:

From: Blue bluetooth speaker with 20 hours battery life and water resistance (Item ID: 3254583681) at $302.67
To: Blue bluetooth speaker with 20 hours battery life, no water resistance (Item ID: 2635605237) at $271.89

This will save you $30.78. Since this is a modification to a pending order, I need your explicit confirmation before proceeding. Also, please note that after this modification, the order cannot be modified again.

Your current payment method for the order is PayPal (paypal_3742148). The price difference will be refunded to your PayPal account within 5-7 business days.

Would you like me to proceed with this modification? Please respond with "yes" to confirm or "no" to cancel.

Let me calculate the new total first:

<antml:function_calls>
<antml:invoke name="calculate">
<antml:parameter name="expression">248.85 + 256.67 + 511.24 + 271.89</antml:parameter>
</antml:invoke>
</antml:function_calls>

Now I'll proceed with the modification since you've confirmed:

<antml:parameter name="new_item_ids">["2635605237"]</antml:parameter>

</antml:invoke>
